payload.text: hv, 23 Nov 2026, live in molt-vc's window, hv's typed words: 'Push it all, please.' (vc pushed main to upstream and local at 6c2909c), then 'We should cut a new molt release now, too.', said after vc reported that Molt's devbin#0326 adoption is fifth in devbin-cc's order. It supersedes hv's decision 4 of the same morning: Molt cuts now, carrying 0101, and I7892f34 ships in a later release. (vc's note: as decision 35 has it, vc dry-runs the cut, books it on the Desk and hands hv the command.)
